title: Plumeform at a glance (v2)
description: A dark band with a heavy left-aligned heading over a bento of frosted glass stat cards: a tall card whose huge paper-to-mint numeral sits at its foot, two compact cards with the label above the figure and a note below, and a wide card along the bottom. Cards rise and un-blur into view one after another.
notes: dark by itself (dark class); the backdrop is a placeholder until given a video or WebGL scene
made for four stats: the first is tall, the last is wide; other counts fall back to a plain grid
